verdict.rationale: Carta documents a public REST API with OAuth 2.0 (authorization code and client credentials), a playground environment, a path to production, a Postman guide, and per-endpoint reference pages. The endpoints mostly retrieve cap tables, stakeholders, option grants, notes and FMVs, with some write operations such as creating draft option grants and draft issuers. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes found 404 at all candidate paths), stable non-alpha endpoint versions (reference paths are v1alpha1), broader write/action coverage beyond drafts, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
